distribution: Invitation-only beta; request platform access. Do not infer installed-build availability from production flags.

capabilities.name: Just run
capabilities.scope: Time and distance without a preset route or pace; stored on the phone.

capabilities.name: Solo targets
capabilities.scope: Mapped-route finish-time goal or eligible previous effort on the same course and direction.

capabilities.name: Fair start
capabilities.scope: Pace-adjusted personal start; recent 5K pace required.

capabilities.name: Same start
capabilities.scope: No pace needed when unrestricted; pace-limited entries still require pace.

capabilities.name: Hosting
capabilities.scope: Host only or host and race. Unstarted races have a 48-hour late-start grace period; rescheduling remains possible later.

capabilities.name: Calendar
capabilities.scope: Google Calendar draft or ICS export; not automatic calendar updates or Garmin Calendar integration.

capabilities.name: Apple Health export
capabilities.scope: Optional eligible finished races and Just runs; availability depends on installed beta.

capabilities.name: Health Connect export
capabilities.scope: Disabled in production configuration pending Android release work.

capabilities.name: FIT and GPX export
capabilities.scope: Finished race files for manual upload; no automatic Garmin or Strava publishing.

capabilities.name: Milestones
capabilities.scope: Private progress milestones; not a public badge leaderboard.

capabilities.name: Paid races, payouts, Weekly and rides
capabilities.scope: Not part of the current free running beta promise.
